name: Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Ferrari' 2025
story_html: The 2025 edition of the Air Jordan 14 Retro 'Ferrari' brings back a bold colorway that emphasizes the shoe's automotive influences. True to the original 2014 release, the championship silhouette utilizes a one-piece scarlet suede upper with contrasting black accents on the tongue, collar lining and heel panel, marked with an embossed Jumpman and '23' in Vibrant Yellow. A matching yellow Jumpman badge decorates the lateral collar. Accented with faux carbon fiber detailing, the black Phylon midsole features an exposed chrome-plated chassis and springy Zoom Air units in the forefoot and heel.
